335: The place where commencement is found, from the Ancient Holy One, which is illuminated by the Mazal, it [is] a light of Chochma/Wisdom which is being stretched forth into thirty-two sides.  And it goes out from that concealed brain, from the light that is in it. And what the Ancient Holy One shines [forth] at first (another reading: “with Chochma/Wisdom”), that is it. And [it is] (being) the commencement of what has been revealed, and it became three heads, and one head encompasses them. And these three [heads] are being stretched forth to the Small Countenance, and from these all shine.
